description: Makes the pack. Only `skill` and `grade` are required; everything else has a sensible default.

chart.description: The string "blank", or an object { "mode": "filled" | "blank" }; the string form is normalised to { "mode": "blank" } before sending.

focus.description: Single-number drill, e.g. the 7 times table.

includeAnswerKeys.description: Include answer keys. On by default.

seed.description: Seed to reproduce an identical pack.

shopName.description: Shop name printed on the pack.

skill.description: The skill to drill, e.g. multiplication; must be one list_skills returns.

theme.description: One of ten colour palettes. Defaults to teal.

title.description: Pack title. Defaults to Math Lesson; trimmed at 80 chars.

worksheetCount.description: Number of worksheets in the pack.

name: generate_worksheet_pack
